jurisdiction_label: United Arab Emirates — Emirate of Abu Dhabi

framework.name: Emirate of Abu Dhabi Road Safety Audit Manual (DMT) / QCC TR-540
framework.publisher: Department of Municipalities and Transport, Abu Dhabi; standardized by Abu Dhabi Quality and Conformity Council
framework.qualification_note: Scope is the Emirate of Abu Dhabi road network only [EV-AE-001]; Abu Dhabi semantics are jurisdiction-specific, never universal. Dubai RTA manual exists but contents unverified; other Emirates: none found.

stages.definition: Audit of concept/master-plan options, route alignments, plan conformance, tie-ins to the existing network, junction formats and land-take constraints; attaches to Master Plan and Traffic Impact Study submissions when triggered.
stages.trigger: Master Plan / Traffic Impact Study submission [EV-AE-005].
stages.notes: Native Stage 0 — jurisdiction-specific; must not be presented as a neutral default.

stages.definition: Audit of general-arrangement drawings (route alignment, vertical profile, typical cross-sections) and junction/interchange layouts at larger scale; reviews prior Stage 0 report/responses.
Single combined preliminary+detailed-design audit explicitly permitted for smaller schemes; brief covers the union of both input sets in one report.
Full detailed-design set plus departures/relaxations from standard, traffic signal phasing diagrams, all prior audit reports/response forms.
Substantially-complete works audited on site with police and highway-authority representatives; ITC detour permits hard-wire Stage 3 approval into close-out.

exceptions.condition: Explicitly permitted for smaller schemes per the manual.
This pack represents Abu Dhabi only; it does not bind Dubai or other Emirates. Dubai manual contents Unknown; no other Emirates manuals found.

inputs.label: Audit brief with project description and purpose (clause 5.10.2 checklist)
A4/A3 markable plans for annotation by the team
Concept/master-plan options, route alignments, development/transport plan
Tie-ins to existing network; junction formats; land-take constraints
General-detail drawings: route alignment, vertical profile, typical cross-sections
Junction/interchange layouts at larger scale (with control devices/signage/markings)
Previous stage audit report(s) and response forms

Detailed-design drawing set: horizontal/vertical alignment, cross-sections (lanes, shoulders, drainage, medians, sidewalks, clear zone, barriers/hazards), intersection layouts with control devices/signage/markings, interchange details (advance/exit signage, accel/decel lanes, gore treatment)

outputs.label: RSA report with problems/findings and recommendations
Client/designer response form to findings
outputs.description: Response forms carried forward between stages.

audit_questions.text: Do the concept/master-plan options differ in safety performance for expected users, and are tie-ins to the existing network safe?
Are sidewalks, median provisions, clear zones and roadside treatments consistent and safe for all user types in the cross-section?
Are interchange details (advance/exit signage, accel/decel lanes, gore treatment) adequate for design vehicles and driver expectancy?
Do signal phasing arrangements protect conflicting movements, including pedestrians?
audit_questions.source_note: Signal phasing diagrams required at Stage 2 [EV-AE-007]

rules.description: Combined Stage 1/2 audits apply only where the scheme meets the manual's smaller-scheme criteria; eligibility must be recorded.
Each stage's brief includes previous reports/responses; unresolved issues are reiterated at the following stage.
The team may demand further information if the brief is inadequate; inadequacy surfaces as missing-information artifacts.

sources.title: Emirate of Abu Dhabi Road Safety Audit Manual (First Edition)
sources.publisher: Department of Municipal Affairs and Transport / DMT
